The PCA issuer manifest can be applied while the authority is still in PENDING_CERTIFICATE; the CA cannot issue certificates until its signed certificate is associated. Make this manifest wait for the CA certificate association resource.

The PCA certificate issuer is a custom resource, but its CRD is installed by the Kubernetes add-ons module. Without ordering, kubectl_manifest.cluster_pca_issuer may be applied before that chart/CRD exists; make it depend on the add-ons module.

The CA certificate resource can issue its certificate before the authority has been activated by associating its CA certificate. The provider documentation notes a newly created authority remains PENDING_CERTIFICATE and cannot issue until that association completes.
aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng already references the IAM role through node_role_arn, so the explicit dependency on that same role duplicates an implicit dependency.

kubernetes_config_map.aws_auth already waits for data.http.eks_cluster_readiness, which itself reads the EKS cluster and therefore orders after module.aws_eks. The explicit module dependency duplicates that ordering.

kubernetes_config_map.amazon_vpc_cni already waits for data.http.eks_cluster_readiness, which itself reads the EKS cluster and therefore orders after module.aws_eks. The explicit module dependency duplicates that ordering.
The module graph already has an ordinary-reference dependency from this Helm add-on module to the namespace resource, so the matching explicit depends_on duplicates it.
